history.summary: Freehold D15 3BR (926 sqft) at $1.88M / $2,030 psf in a newer 2021 boutique near Marine Parade. Efficiently-sized compact 3BR at a sub-$2M quantum is appealing, but $2,030 psf is ~7% over the $1,894 median and the appreciation rate rides on only 7 transactions (the resale-only figure is a more sober 3.87%).
history.rating_rationale: Modern 2021 freehold stock in D15 with an efficient 926 sqft 3BR layout and the new Marine Parade TEL nearby is a genuine plus, and the $1.88M quantum sits in the deep band. Held back by a ~7% premium over median PSF, thin 7-txn appreciation data (resale-only ~3.87% is the honest read), and boutique-scale liquidity. Net balanced.
red_flags: Only 7 URA txns — appreciation unreliable; resale-only ~3.87%
catalysts: D15 East Coast deep buyer pool
